Whether it's 200 board games, vinyl records, or vintage books, losing sight of what you own means buying duplicates—wasting money on what's already on your shelf. SeniorEase Library solves this with radical simplicity: scan barcodes, keep your collection on your phone, no accounts or subscriptions required. €4.99. Once. Your data stays with you. Privacy first, always. Perfect for collectors who value their collections and their time. Discover how: seniorease.eu #Collections #Privacy #SimpleTools
